## Objective
Cluster mucosal biopsy fragments by principal components of quantiative histology features using k-means 
(PCA, K-means and visualizations)

###  Libraries and functions

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Custom renaming function: ONLY feature name
rename_features_only <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)  # Leave ID variable alone

    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clust",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean size",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD size",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Lymphocyte distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Lymphocyte distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "Junctional distance \\(median\\)") ~ "Median jun dist",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw)
    feature
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
 
rename_custom_vars <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    # If not a 3-part name, return original
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)

    # Original components
    layer <- parts[1]
    compartment <- parts[2]
    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    # Abbreviate compartment
    compartment_abbr <- case_when(
      compartment == "Epithelium" ~ "Epi",
      compartment == "Lamina propria" ~ "LP",
      TRUE ~ compartment
    )

    # Custom feature name abbreviation
    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clust",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean size",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD size",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD dist",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )

    paste0(feature, "\n", layer, " ", compartment_abbr)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}



prepare_pca_full_analysis <- function(df,
                                      id_col = "image_fragment_mucosa_name",
                                      exclude_cols = c("image_fragment_mucosa_name", "image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name"),
                                      scale_data = FALSE,
                                      explore_dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                                      prefix = subset_name) {
  
  if(!dir.exists(explore_dir)) dir.create(explore_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Prepare data
  df_for_pca <- df %>%
    select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Shorten variable names using provided rename function
  short_var_names <- rename_custom_vars(names(df_for_pca))
  colnames(df_for_pca) <- short_var_names
  
  # PCA
  pca <- prcomp(df_for_pca, center = scale_data, scale. = scale_data)
  
  # Scree plot
  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    ylab("Percentage of variance") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9)
  ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, paste0("scree_plot_", prefix, ".png")),
         scree_plot, width = 7, height = 3.3, dpi = 300)
  
  print(scree_plot)
  

  
  # Variable contributions
  var_contrib <- get_pca_var(pca)$contrib %>% as.data.frame()
  var_contrib <- var_contrib %>% 
    rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
    arrange(desc(Dim.1))
  
  # Save contributions table
  write_json(var_contrib, file.path(explore_dir, paste0("variable_contributions_", prefix, ".json")))
  
  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("PC"),
      names_to = "PrincipalComponent",
      values_to = "Loading"
    ) %>%
    filter(PrincipalComponent %in% paste0("PC", 1:4))  
  
  loadings$Variable <- str_replace_all(loadings$Variable, "\n", " - ")
  
  custom_order <- c(
  "Count - Villi LP", "Mean dist - Villi LP", "SD dist - Villi LP",
  "Count - Crypts LP", "Mean dist - Crypts LP", "SD dist - Crypts LP",
  "Count - Villi Epi", "Mean dist - Villi Epi", "SD dist - Villi Epi",
  "Count - Crypts Epi", "Mean dist - Crypts Epi", "SD dist - Crypts Epi",
  "Mean size - Villi LP", "Mean size - Crypts LP",
  "Mean size - Villi Epi", "Mean size - Crypts Epi",
  "SD size - Villi LP", "SD size - Crypts LP",
  "SD size - Villi Epi", "SD size - Crypts Epi",
  "Epi-LP - Villi LP", "Epi-LP - Crypts LP"
  )
  
  # Reorder Variable as factor
  loadings$Variable <- factor(loadings$Variable, levels = custom_order)

  
  var_plot <- ggplot(loadings, aes(x = Variable, y = Loading)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = Variable)) +
    facet_wrap(~ PrincipalComponent, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Variable loadings by principal component",
      y = "Loading", x = "", fill = "Variable"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, paste0("var_load_by_PC_", prefix, ".png")),
         var_plot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  print(var_plot)
  
  # Generate and save biplots 
  pc_count <- min(4, ncol(pca$x))  
  
  biplots <- list()
  for(i in 1:(pc_count-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):pc_count) {
      pcs <- c(i, j)
      contrib_i <- sort(get_pca_var(pca)$contrib[, i], decreasing = TRUE)
      contrib_j <- sort(get_pca_var(pca)$contrib[, j], decreasing = TRUE)
      
      
      # Create biplot
      biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(pca, axes = pcs,
                                geom.ind = "point",
                               # select.var = list(name = top_vars),
                                col.ind = "lightblue",
                               pointsize = 1.2,
                               labelsize = 3,
                                col.var = "contrib",
                                gradient.cols = c("#fd8d3c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
                                repel = TRUE) +
        ggtitle(paste("Biplot PC", i, "vs PC", j)) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9)
      
      # Save plot
      plot_name <- paste0("biplot_PC", i, "_PC", j, "_", prefix, ".png")
      ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, plot_name),
             biplot, width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
      
      biplots[[paste0("PC", i, "_PC", j)]] <- biplot
      
      print(biplot)
    }
  }
  
  # Return results invisibly
  invisible(list(
    pca = pca,
    df_for_pca = df_for_pca,
    scree_plot = scree_plot,
    var_contrib = var_contrib,
    biplots = biplots
  ))
}


plot_kmeans_elbow_silhouette <- function(pca, 
                                         pcs = NULL, 
                                         kmax = NULL, 
                                         explore_dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                                         prefix = subset_name) {
  
  df_for_clust <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, pcs])
  
  # Elbow plot (WSS)
  elbow_plot <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Total within-cluster\nsum of squares"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 1)))

  # Save elbow plot
  elbow_path <- file.path(explore_dir, paste0("elbow_plot_", prefix, ".png"))
  ggsave(filename = elbow_path,
         plot = elbow_plot, width = 7, height = 2.3, dpi = 300)
  
  print(elbow_plot)
  
  # Silhouette plot
  silhouette_plot <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "silhouette", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Average silhouette width"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 1)))
  
  # Save silhouette plot
  silhouette_path <- file.path(explore_dir, paste0("silhouette_plot_", prefix, ".png"))
  ggsave(filename = silhouette_path,
         plot = silhouette_plot, width = 7, height = 2.3, dpi = 300)
  
  print(silhouette_plot)
  
  invisible(list(
    df_for_clust = df_for_clust,
    plots = list(elbow = elbow_plot, silhouette = silhouette_plot),
    paths = list(elbow_plot = elbow_path, silhouette_plot = silhouette_path)
  ))
}

cluster_k <- function(pca,
                      best_k,
                      original_df,
                      pcs_used = NULL,
                      dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                      prefix = subset_name) {
  set.seed(123)
  
  df_for_clust <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, pcs_used])

  km <- kmeans(df_for_clust, centers = best_k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
  
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(df_for_clust))
  sil_df <- as.data.frame(sil)
  cluster_silhouette <- sil_df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(mean_silhouette = mean(sil_width), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(mean_silhouette = round(mean_silhouette, 2))
  
  
  cluster_assignments <- original_df %>%
    mutate(cluster = km$cluster[match(rownames(original_df), rownames(df_for_clust))])
  
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((df_for_clust - km$centers[km$cluster, ])^2))
  cluster_assignments$distance_to_center <- distances[match(rownames(original_df), rownames(df_for_clust))]
  
  cluster_medians <- cluster_assignments %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(median_value = median(`Villi_Lamina propria_Count`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(median_value) %>%
    mutate(new_cluster = row_number())
  
  cluster_assignments <- cluster_assignments %>%
    left_join(cluster_medians, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(cluster_label = paste0("Cluster ", new_cluster),
           cluster_number = as.character(new_cluster)) %>%
    select(- median_value)
  
  cluster_summary <- cluster_silhouette %>%
    left_join(cluster_medians, by = "cluster") %>%
    mutate(cluster_label = paste0("Cluster ", new_cluster)) %>%
    select(new_cluster, cluster_label, mean_silhouette) %>%
    arrange(new_cluster) %>%
    mutate(cluster_number = as.character(new_cluster)) %>%
    select(cluster_number, mean_silhouette)
  
  
  write_json(cluster_assignments, file.path(dir, paste0("cluster_assignments_", prefix, ".json")), pretty = TRUE)
  
  palette <- if (best_k <= 8) brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[1:best_k] else
    if (best_k <= 12) brewer.pal(best_k, "Set3") else
      colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(best_k)
  
  make_pca_cluster_plot <- function(pc_x, pc_y) {
    fviz_pca_ind(
      pca,
      axes = c(pc_x, pc_y),
      geom.ind = "point",
      pointshape = 21,
      alpha.ind = 0.5,
      fill.ind = factor(cluster_assignments$cluster_label[match(rownames(df_for_clust), rownames(original_df))]),
      col.ind = "black",
      palette = palette,
      addEllipses = TRUE,
      ellipse.level = 0.90,
      repel = TRUE,
      legend.title = "Cluster"
    ) +
    ggtitle(paste("Clusters on PC", pc_x, "vs PC", pc_y)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 9))
  }

  # Generate PCA cluster plots
  pc_combinations <- list(c(1,2), c(1,3), c(1,4), c(2,3), c(2,4))
  plots <- list()
  for(pcs in pc_combinations) {
    p <- make_pca_cluster_plot(pcs[1], pcs[2])
    ggsave(filename = file.path(dir, paste0("pca_clusters_PC", pcs[1], "_PC", pcs[2], "_", prefix, ".png")),
           plot = p, width = 7, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
    plots[[paste0("PC", pcs[1], "_PC", pcs[2])]] <- p
    print(p)
  }
  
  # Boxplots of unscaled features
  unscaled_features <- original_df %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(cluster_label = cluster_assignments$cluster_label,
           cluster_number = cluster_assignments$cluster_number)

  long_unscaled <- unscaled_features %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(cluster_label, cluster_number), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(FeatureLabel = rename_custom_vars(Feature)) %>%
    separate(FeatureLabel, into = c("FeatureShort", "Region"), sep = "\n", remove = FALSE)

  feature_order <- c("Count", "Mean dist", "SD dist", "Mean size", "SD size", "Epi-LP")
  region_order <- c("Villi LP", "Crypts LP", "Villi Epi", "Crypts Epi")

  long_unscaled$FeatureShort <- factor(long_unscaled$FeatureShort, levels = feature_order)
  long_unscaled$Region <- factor(long_unscaled$Region, levels = region_order)

  boxplot_plot <- ggplot(long_unscaled, aes(x = cluster_number, y = Value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(FeatureShort ~ Region, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
          strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Feature value", title = "Unscaled feature distribution by cluster")

  ggsave(file.path(dir, paste0("boxplots_unscaled_features_", prefix, ".png")),
         boxplot_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  print(boxplot_plot)
  
  #Ranked heatmap of cluster medians
  
  custom_var_order <- c(
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Count",
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Count",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio",
    "Villi_Epithelium_Count",
    "Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
    "Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
    "Crypts_Epithelium_Count",
    "Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)",
    "Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)",
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Size (mean)",
    "Villi_Lamina propria_Size (sd)",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (mean)",
    "Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (sd)",
    "Villi_Epithelium_Size (mean)",
    "Villi_Epithelium_Size (sd)",
    "Crypts_Epithelium_Size (mean)",
    "Crypts_Epithelium_Size (sd)"
  )
  
  cluster_medians_all <- cluster_assignments %>%
    group_by(cluster_number, cluster_label) %>%
    summarise(across(matches("^(Crypts|Villi)"), 
                   median, 
                   .names = "{.col}_median"),
            .groups = "drop")
  
  cluster_quartiles <- cluster_assignments %>%
    group_by(cluster_number, cluster_label) %>%
    summarise(across(matches("^(Crypts|Villi)"), list(q1 = ~quantile(., 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                      q3 = ~quantile(., 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))), .groups = "drop")
  
  cluster_medians_all_extended <- cluster_medians_all %>%
    left_join(cluster_quartiles, by = c("cluster_number", "cluster_label"))
  
  summary_long <- cluster_medians_all_extended %>%
    select(cluster_number, ends_with("median"), ends_with("_q1"), ends_with("_q3")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-cluster_number, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Type = case_when(
        grepl("_q1$", Variable) ~ "Q1",
        grepl("_q3$", Variable) ~ "Q3",
        grepl("_median$", Variable) ~ "Median",
        TRUE ~ NA),
      Variable = Variable %>%
        str_remove("_median$") %>%
        str_remove("_q1$") %>%
        str_remove("_q3$")
    )
  
 summary_long$Variable <- factor(summary_long$Variable, levels = custom_var_order)
 summary_long$Type <- factor(summary_long$Type, levels = c("Median", "Q1", "Q3"))
 
 summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
  arrange(cluster_number, Variable, Type) %>%
  unite("Var_Type", Variable, Type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Var_Type, values_from = Value) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 1))) %>%
   left_join(cluster_summary) %>%
   mutate(
     `Count - villi lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Count_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Count_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Count_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean dist - villi lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD dist - villi lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Epi-to-lp ratio - villi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Q3`, ")"),
     `Count - crypts lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Count_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Count_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Count_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean dist - crypts lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD dist - crypts lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Epi-to-lp ratio - crypts (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio_Q3`, ")"),
     `Count - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Epithelium_Count_Median`, " (", `Villi_Epithelium_Count_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Epithelium_Count_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean dist - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD dist - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
      `Count - crypts epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Epithelium_Count_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Epithelium_Count_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Epithelium_Count_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean dist - crypts epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD dist - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Epithelium_Lymphocyte distance (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean size - villi lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD size - villi lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean size - crypts lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD size - crypts lp (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Lamina propria_Size (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean size - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD size - villi epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Villi_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Median`, " (", `Villi_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Villi_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Q3`, ")"),
     `Mean size - crypts epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Epithelium_Size (mean)_Q3`, ")"),
     `SD size - crypts epi (median, iqr)` = paste0(`Crypts_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Median`, " (", `Crypts_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Q1`, "-", `Crypts_Epithelium_Size (sd)_Q3`, ")")) %>%
   rename(Cluster = cluster_number,
          `Mean silhouette` = mean_silhouette) %>%
   select(Cluster, `Mean silhouette`, `Count - villi lp (median, iqr)`: `SD size - crypts epi (median, iqr)`)


  ranked_medians <- cluster_medians_all %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("_median$", "", .x), .cols = ends_with("_median")) %>%
    select(cluster_number, all_of(custom_var_order)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("cluster_number") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    apply(2, rank) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  pretty_labels <- gsub("\n", " ",
                        rename_custom_vars(rownames(ranked_medians)))
  rownames(ranked_medians) <- pretty_labels
  
  heatmap_plot <- pheatmap(ranked_medians,
                         cluster_rows = FALSE,
                         cluster_cols = FALSE,
                         display_numbers = TRUE,
                         main = "Cluster Rankings by Median Value",
                         angle_col = 45,
                         silent = TRUE)
  # Save manually
  ggsave(file.path(dir, paste0("ranked_cluster_heatmap_", prefix, ".png")),
       plot = heatmap_plot[[4]], width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  # Print to screen
  print(heatmap_plot)
  
  
  
  
  
  invisible(list(
    clustered_data = cluster_assignments,
    cluster_summary =  summary_wide,
    cluster_object = km,
    pca_plots = plots,
    boxplot = boxplot_plot
  ))
}
```

For disseratation chapter (does not include large images from aiforia)

```{r}
subset_name <- "full"
filtered_scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_",subset_name ,".json")) %>%
  select(- ends_with("_Junctional distance (median)")) 
     
  
pca_prep <- prepare_pca_full_analysis(filtered_scaled)
var_cont <- pca_prep$var_contrib

#Elbows & Silhouettes 
pca <- pca_prep$pca
explore_ks <- plot_kmeans_elbow_silhouette(pca, pcs = 1:4, kmax = 30)



#K-means
filtered_unscaled <- fromJSON(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_unscaled_",subset_name ,".json")) %>%
     select(- ends_with("_Junctional distance (median)")) 

k_means_9 <- cluster_k(pca, best_k = 9, filtered_unscaled, pcs_used = 1:4, dir = cluster_prep_dir, prefix = subset_name)

k_means_data <- k_means_9$clustered_data

cluster_summary <- k_means_9$cluster_summary 



# Step 1: Pivot longer all variables except Cluster and Mean Silhouette
long_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Cluster, `Mean Silhouette`), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

# Step 2: Extract measurement type and location
long_summary <- long_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = case_when(
      str_detect(Variable, "_Median") ~ "Median",
      str_detect(Variable, "_Q1") ~ "Q1",
      str_detect(Variable, "_Q3") ~ "Q3"
    ),
    CleanVar = Variable %>%
      str_remove("_Median") %>%
      str_remove("_Q1") %>%
      str_remove("_Q3")
  )

# Step 3: Pivot wider to have columns: Cluster, CleanVar, Median, Q1, Q3
wide_summary <- long_summary %>%
  select(Cluster, `Mean Silhouette`, CleanVar, Measure, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = Value)

wide_summary <- wide_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Median = as.numeric(Median),
    Q1 = as.numeric(Q1),
    Q3 = as.numeric(Q3)
  )

# Step 4: Combine into final format "median (q1 – q3)"
cluster_summary_for_paper <- wide_summary %>%
  mutate(Summary = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", Median, Q1, Q3)) %>%
  select(Cluster, `Mean Silhouette`, CleanVar, Summary) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CleanVar, values_from = Summary)

# Optional: clean column names to title case and replace underscores
colnames(cluster_summary_for_paper) <- colnames(cluster_summary_for_paper) %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
  str_to_title()

# View result
cluster_summary_for_paper


cluster_data <- k_means_9$clustered_data

examples <- cluster_data %>%
  group_by(cluster_label) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = distance_to_center, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

write_xlsx(examples, paste0(cluster_prep_dir, "three_central_examples_from_each_cluster.xlsx"))

# Step 1: Select one cluster ID column, and rename it "Cluster"
clean_summary <- cluster_summary %>%
  transmute(Cluster = new_cluster, `Mean Silhouette` = mean_silhouette)

# Step 2: Reorder and reshape the summary table with medians, Q1, Q3
# Combine medians, q1, and q3 from the extended table
summary_long <- cluster_summary %>%
  select(cluster_number, all_of(custom_var_order), ends_with("_q1"), ends_with("_q3")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster_number, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Type = case_when(
      grepl("_q1$", Variable) ~ "Q1",
      grepl("_q3$", Variable) ~ "Q3",
      TRUE ~ "Median"
    ),
    Variable = Variable %>%
      str_remove("_q1$") %>%
      str_remove("_q3$")
  )

# Step 3: Reorder variables and types
summary_long$Variable <- factor(summary_long$Variable, levels = custom_var_order)
summary_long$Type <- factor(summary_long$Type, levels = c("Median", "Q1", "Q3"))

# Step 4: Pivot to wide format with variables ordered by type
summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
  arrange(cluster_number, Variable, Type) %>%
  unite("Var_Type", Variable, Type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Var_Type, values_from = Value)

# Step 5: Merge clean summary table with cluster-level values
final_summary <- clean_summary %>%
  left_join(summary_wide, by = c("Cluster" = "cluster_number"))

# Step 6: Rename columns using pretty labels
colnames(final_summary)[-1:-2] <- gsub(

)
```

### Intergrate with diagnosis (from parse_path)
```{r}
pca <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/clustering/pca_all.rds")

k_means_9 <- readRDS("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/clustering/k_means_all.rds")

subset_name <- "all"

filtered_scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_", subset_name, ".json")) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_Junctional distance (median)"))

id_col <- "image_fragment_mucosa_name"
exclude_cols <- c("image_fragment_mucosa_name", "image_name", "fragment_name", "mucosa_name")

features_only <- filtered_scaled %>% select(-all_of(exclude_cols))
keep <- complete.cases(features_only)
ids_kept <- filtered_scaled[[id_col]][keep]

scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  mutate(!!id_col := ids_kept) %>%
  relocate(!!id_col)

original_dx <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/parse_path_report/all_wsis_simplified_dx.json")

dx_complex <- original_dx %>% select(image_name, complex_dx)
combined <- filtered_scaled %>% left_join(dx_complex, by = "image_name")
metadata_dx_complex <- combined %>% select(image_fragment_mucosa_name, complex_dx)



scores_dx_complex <- scores %>%
  left_join(metadata_dx_complex %>% select(!!sym(id_col), complex_dx), by = id_col) 

dx_colors <- c(
  "Mild LPE" = "#9ecae1",
  "Moderate LPE" = "#4292c6",
  "Marked LPE" = "#084594",
  "LPE NOS" = "#bcbddc",
  "SCL" = "#fdd0a2",
  "ICL" = "#fd8d3c",
  "LCL" = "#cb181d",
  "Lymphoma NOS" = "#fee0d2",
  "Lymphoma & Enteritis" = "#662506",
  "Other" = "#ffeda0",
  "Normal" = "#a1d99b")

# lock factor order in legend (optional but nice)
scores_dx_complex <- scores_dx_complex %>%
  mutate(original_diagnosis = fct_relevel(complex_dx, names(dx_colors), after = 0))

# ---------- 3) Axis labels ----------
pc_var <- pca$sdev^2
var_exp <- pc_var / sum(pc_var)
x_lab <- sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", 100 * var_exp[1])
y_lab <- sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", 100 * var_exp[2])

# ---------- 4) EVERYTHING plot (PC1 vs PC2, colored by dx) ----------
scores_plot <- scores_dx_complex %>%
  filter(is.finite(PC1), is.finite(PC2)) %>%
  add_count(original_diagnosis, name = "n_dx")

p_pca_dx <- ggplot(scores_plot, aes(PC1, PC2, color = original_diagnosis)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = dx_colors, drop = TRUE) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Original diagnosis", override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, title = "PCA: PC1 vs PC2 colored by original diagnosis")

print(p_pca_dx)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(cluster_prep_dir, paste0("pca_PC1_PC2_by_original_diagnosis_", subset_name, ".png")),
  plot = p_pca_dx, width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300
)
```

### Plot individual clusters (to crop for insets fig. 14)
```{r}

# ---------- 5) CLUSTER-BY-CLUSTER HIGHLIGHTS ----------
scores_dx_complex <- scores_dx_complex %>%
  left_join(
    k_means_9$clustered_data %>% select(!!rlang::sym(id_col), cluster_label, cluster_number),
    by = id_col
  )

plot_df_full <- scores_dx_complex %>%
  filter(is.finite(PC1), is.finite(PC2)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_number = as.factor(cluster_number),
         original_diagnosis = fct_relevel(original_diagnosis, names(dx_colors), after = 0))

make_cluster_highlight <- function(cluster_id) {
  df <- plot_df_full
  focal <- df %>% filter(cluster_number == cluster_id)

  can_ellipse <- nrow(focal) >= 3

  ggplot() +
    # non-focal: light grey
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(cluster_number != cluster_id),
      aes(PC1, PC2),
      color = "grey85", alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2
    ) +
    # focal: colored by dx using the SAME palette
    geom_point(
      data = focal,
      aes(PC1, PC2, color = original_diagnosis),
      alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8
    )  +
    scale_color_manual(values = dx_colors, drop = TRUE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Original diagnosis",
                                override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(
      x = x_lab, y = y_lab,
      title = paste0("Cluster ", cluster_id, " highlighted"),
      subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(focal))
    )
}

clusters <- sort(unique(plot_df_full$cluster_number))
plots <- lapply(clusters, make_cluster_highlight)
names(plots) <- paste0("cluster_", clusters)

for (cl in clusters) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(cluster_prep_dir,
                         paste0("pca_PC1_PC2_highlight_cluster_", cl, "_", subset_name, ".png")),
    plot = plots[[paste0("cluster_", cl)]],
    width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300
  )
}
```
